spec_match.rationale: Measures every overflow pair's computed values on real elements and tests whether each axis actually scrolls — specified-vs-computed is exactly the feature's crux.

interactive.rationale: Pair table generated from live getComputedStyle and scroll attempts; controls re-measure.

edge_cases.rationale: Includes the coercion rules (visible pairing, clip pairing) and the this-build-coerces case.

conformance.rationale: Suite correct; the two scroll-clip assertions fail on this build because the feature is absent (recorded on the sibling critique).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Live measurements showed scroll/clip computing to scroll/hidden here — the honest pre-feature answer; console clean.

accessibility.rationale: Table headers scoped, aria-live output, visible focus.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 screenshots captured and inspected. The measurement table is the clearest statement of this build's real (coerced) behaviour.
